_comments: FITS business semantics and SQL builder hints

column_logic.productivity: COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 2 THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*)
column_logic.overdue_count: COUNT(CASE WHEN scheduled_date < NOW() AND status < 2 THEN 1 END)
column_logic.completion_rate: SUM(CASE WHEN status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)
column_logic.high_priority_open: COUNT(CASE WHEN priority >= 2 AND status IN (0, 1) THEN 1 END)

filter_context.task_status_filter: status IN (0, 1, 2, 3) maps to (Pending, In Progress, Completed, Overdue)
filter_context.priority_filter: priority IN (0, 1, 2, 3) maps to (Low, Medium, High, Critical)
filter_context.facility_scope: task_transaction.facility_id must match user's assigned facilities
filter_context.date_scope: scheduled_date filters should use facility timezone

common_queries.pending_tasks_today: SELECT * FROM task_transaction WHERE DATE(scheduled_date) = CURDATE() AND status = 0
common_queries.overdue_tasks: SELECT * FROM task_transaction WHERE scheduled_date < CURDATE() AND status IN (0, 1)
common_queries.high_priority: SELECT * FROM task_transaction WHERE priority IN (2, 3) ORDER BY priority DESC, scheduled_date ASC
common_queries.facility_summary: SELECT facility_id, COUNT(*) as total_tasks, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as completed FROM task_transaction GROUP BY facility_id
common_queries.overdue_by_user: SELECT assigned_user_id, COUNT(*) as overdue_count FROM task_transaction WHERE scheduled_date < NOW() AND status < 2 GROUP BY assigned_user_id
